$comment: The stable error codes clients branch on (protocols.md §1c). `retryable` means the identical request may succeed if simply retried soon; it never means 'could succeed after an operator changes the fleet'. Each component defines these in its own code and a conformance test checks it against this file.

invalid_request.description: The request is malformed: a missing or invalid field, header or deadline.

not_found.description: No such resource, e.g. an unknown job or reservation id.

fleet_not_configured.description: The coordinator has no fleet registry, so nothing can be routed.

capability_not_found.description: The named capability alias is not in the fleet registry.

capability_misconfigured.description: The alias is registered but cannot be served, e.g. a provider account whose API key is unset. An operator fix.

ability_unsatisfied.description: No artifact clears the requested min_ability for the task class.

requirements_unsatisfied.description: No artifact declares what `requires` asks for. Often one catalog entry away.

cloud_not_permitted.description: The named tier is cloud, and the job's privacy or urgency forbids cloud.

cloud_budget_exhausted.description: The named tier is cloud, and the cloud budget does not allow it.

reservation_invalid.description: The named reservation is unknown or not confirmed.

conflict.description: The request conflicts with the resource's current state.

model_server_unreachable.description: The model server could not be connected to.

model_server_timeout.description: The model server did not answer in time.

model_server_error.description: The model server answered with a server error or a malformed response.

model_request_rejected.description: The model server refused the request itself, e.g. it exceeds the context window.

artifact_not_installed.description: The node that claimed the job does not have the artifact it was pinned to.

model_substituted.description: The model server answered with a different model than the one pinned.

job_expired.description: The job passed its deadline or the maximum queue age unserved.

job_cancelled.description: The job was withdrawn by DELETE /jobs/{id}.

job_orphaned.description: The job's queue entry is gone and cannot be recovered. Resubmit under a fresh key.

job_abandoned.description: Workers repeatedly abandoned the job until the reaper gave up.

worker_failed.description: The job failed without a classified cause (an older worker, or an unexpected error).
